claim: Measured on a 192x64 block, DDMA constant fill (0.07 us a byte) beat CPU PUSH fill (0.20); dithered fills cannot use it, a pattern-row copy is no faster than PUSH, and per-row jobs lose.
limit: Hardware is assumed equal to CSpect in the notes; JNext 1.3.0 has no DDMA.

evidence.text: CSpect 4.5.9, 192x64 block, us a byte: LDIR 0.76, zxnDMA 0.18-0.21, DDMA 2D copy 0.18, PUSH fill 0.20, DDMA constant fill 0.07; dither rules constant fill out; only the view copy gains.
